description: Figure 1 is a bar chart that illustrates the average performance and token count of different models, specifically Chain of Unconscious Thought (CoUT) and baselines, across four benchmarks. The chart has two axes: the vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 70% to 95%, and the horizontal axis lists four different benchmarks. There are four sets of bars for each benchmark, each set representing a different model or baseline. The models are CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT, each with a distinct color. The bars are arranged in descending order of accuracy, with the tallest bar representing the highest accuracy. The chart is used to compare the performance of these models in terms of accuracy and token efficiency.
